Dear Brightloop Support,

I am writing to express my significant dissatisfaction with the Aura thermostat I purchased on February 3, 2025 under order number BL-731846. While the device was initially promising, over the past six weeks it has exhibited increasingly erratic behavior, cycling between heating and cooling modes without any apparent trigger from my part. The scheduled temperatures I have configured are being ignored on what appears to be a random basis — approximately two to three times per week the unit will override my settings and run the furnace for over an hour at a temperature I never selected. I have performed a full factory reset twice, updated the firmware to the latest version available in the app, and tried re-pairing the device through both Wi-Fi and the hub, yet the problem persists. The energy bill for this month is already noticeably higher than usual, which is the opposite of what I was led to expect from a product marketed on efficiency gains. I would like to know what your position is on resolving this matter, as I am growing increasingly concerned about the reliability of a device that I am trusting with my home's climate control. I would appreciate a prompt response.

Regards,
Marcus Webb

Dear Brightloop Support,

I am writing to request assistance with setting up the Glow strip lights I received earlier this month. I have three rolls of the 5-meter strips and two controllers, and I have been unable to get them to respond to the app despite following the included instructions and the setup guide available on your website. The strips power on and display a solid white light, but when I attempt to add them through the app, the device never appears in the scan list. I have tried resetting the strips by unplugging the power adapter for thirty seconds and then reconnecting, as suggested in the troubleshooting section, but the behavior remains exactly the same.

I am running the Brightloop app version 4.2.1 on an iPhone 15 with iOS 17.4, and my router is running on a 2.4 GHz network, which I understand is required. I have also confirmed that the strips are within range of the Wi-Fi router, as the signal strength on my phone at that location is full bars. I have tried the setup process on two different phones to rule out a device-specific issue, and the result is identical each time.

I would greatly appreciate it if you could walk me through any additional steps or let me know if there is a known compatibility issue with the current firmware. I am happy to provide any further information or screenshots that may help diagnose the problem. Thank you for your patience and assistance.

Kind regards,
Robert
